column1: # mapping_set_title: Mellea LinkML schema to gist (LinkML port) entity mappings

# mapping_set_description: SSSOM mappings from mellea LinkML schema classes (https://w3id.org/lmodel/mellea/) to the gist 14.1.0 LinkML port (https://w3id.org/lmodel/gist/). The gist_linkml prefix points to the lmodel LinkML port of gist to avoid collision with the upstream Semantic Arts namespace (gist_upstream).
# mapping_tool: manual curation against mellea/schema/mellea.yaml and mappings/gist/gist_core.yaml (gist 14.1.0)

column8: comment
Both serve as the abstract top-of-hierarchy class with stable identity.
RepositoryCatalog is a tree-root grouping of declared model elements; aligns with gist:Collection (a grouping of items). Existing close_mappings already include spdx:Sbom.
A PythonPackage is a logical container that declares constituent ModelElements; aligns with gist:Composite (something composed of parts).
Abstract base for all *Spec classes; broader than gist:Specification because it also covers non-specification element kinds.
BackendSpec specifies a backend implementation; structurally a Specification.
FormatterSpec specifies an output formatter; structurally a Specification.
ContextSpec specifies a context implementation; structurally a Specification.
A Mellea session is a unit of work executed by a backend; related to gist:Task. Existing related_mappings already include mcp:Task and iso27001:RiskAssessmentProcess.
Lexical and conceptual alignment: a stdlib Component is a part that participates in a session/composite.
Direct lexical and conceptual alignment of the requirement notion.
A sampling strategy expresses runtime behavior; related to gist:Behavior.
A plugin is a pluggable Component registered against hook lifecycle stages; relation rather than equivalence.
A hook payload model is a structured content expression carried through lifecycle events.
A telemetry metric describes a measurable magnitude; mellea-side close_mappings to nexus:MetricConfig and iso27001:MonitoringItem already exist.
A CLI command specification acts as a template for an invocation task; gist:TaskTemplate is the closer specialization of Specification.
ApiModelSpec defines an HTTP API wire model; structurally a Specification with fields.
An API field is a constituent part of an ApiModelSpec; aligns with gist:Component.
A method describes invocable runtime behavior of a class.
Cross-provider identifier table for a model; aligns with gist:ID (identifier concept).
A LoRA/aLoRA adapter is a pluggable component attached to a base model.
